name: Sandra AI
long_description: Sandra AI is building the AI operating system for car dealerships, replacing clumsy legacy software with an AI-native, automation-driven platform. Founded by 3 McKinsey, HEC & MIT alumni who met 10 years ago at Ecole Polytechnique, the company’s AI agents already automates all customer interactions across calls & messages, and increasingly run dealership operations by automating sales and aftersales workflows end-to-end. This operational footprint naturally extends into a proprietary software layer that unifies billing, scheduling, inventory, and CRM into a single dealership OS.
one_liner: Building AI employees for car dealers

launches.title: 🚗 Sandra AI – The first multilingual AI receptionist for car dealerships
launches.tagline: 📞 Voice AI that manages all dealership calls, 🌟 boosting customer experience and 💸 driving revenue growth.
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Sandra AI is the first multilingual AI receptionist specifically designed for car dealerships, ensuring that every customer opportunity is captured. Our voice AI solution manages both inbound and outbound calls, allowing dealership teams to focus on closing deals and providing exceptional in-person service while we handle call management.

**See Sandra AI in action:** [Watch our demo here.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=USVY_NldBmY&ab_channel=SandraAI)

### **The Problem: Missed calls = Missed opportunities + Low customer satisfaction**

📞 **+80% of appointments** at car service centers are **still booked by phone**, diverting teams from focusing on in-person customers.

💰 **+30% of inbound calls go unanswered**, leading to significant missed opportunities.

⏳ Customers expect quick responses, but **delays and slow follow-ups** drive them to competitors.

😠 **Traditional call centers are expensive** and struggle to meet high demand, resulting in frustrated customers and lost revenue.

### **Our Solution: Sandra AI**

**💬 Multilingual, human-like interactions –** Sandra communicates naturally in multiple languages, making it easy to connect with a diverse customer base\*\*.\*\*

**🤝 Seamless DMS integration –** Sandra integrates with your dealership management systems, enabling personalized communication and seamless appointment scheduling.

**🔄 Always on, 24/7 –** Sandra never misses a call, capturing leads and managing customer follow-ups at any time of the day.

**🔀 Smart transfer –** Sandra follows your guidelines, transferring to your support teams at just the right moment.

**📝 Observability –** Sandra offers full observability, including call recordings, transcripts, and customer satisfaction overviews.

### **Why we created Sandra AI**

We are passionate about AI, innovation, and making a meaningful impact in the world. Our experience as consultants in the BPO and automotive sectors revealed how missed calls were costing dealerships significant revenue and harming customer relationships.

This insight inspired us to develop a solution that leverages AI to drive real change. Thus, Sandra AI was born—an AI receptionist tailored to address the unique challenges faced by car dealerships.

### **Our Ask**

If you run a car dealership and want to automate your phone call operations, reach out to us at [founders@sandra-ai.com](mailto:founders@sandra-ai.com). We’d love to help you streamline your customer communication and increase sales.

If you know other dealerships that would benefit from Sandra AI, we’d greatly appreciate an introduction!
